## 2026-11-13T19:45Z Creative render completes end to end for the first time

Run `43483476413` at `49703e58` is the first run where the full creative path passed: reference analysis, authoring, and **Render and repair creative candidates** all report success. The visual-gate retry (`fb71995a`) and the analyzer fixes are working.

The preview build then rejected the candidate, correctly:

- `decision: reject`, `promotionReady: false`
- Hard failure: `contrast fail: / desktop default ... a:nth-of-type(2) text "0598020802" (1.000; required 4.5); foreground #14201d, background variable; overlapping non-ancestor paint requires rendered review, resolved from rendered pixels`
- Plus at least one `contrast unresolved` focus finding

That is a real defect in the authored candidate (a dark ink link over an unmeasured backdrop in the hero), not a template bug. With the preview policy now at one candidate and one repair cycle there is no second candidate to select, so the single defect rejects the render and the run fails before the pack fallback can deploy.

This is the trade the one-candidate policy makes, and it needs a decision: either raise the repair-cycle bound for preview, or let a near-miss candidate deliver with warnings when the only failure is an advisory contrast class that the local design repair can fix after delivery.

### Root cause of the remaining reject

The failing selector sits inside `astro-island`, the hydrated client boundary. `verify-rendered-revision` audits the built page including hydrated islands, while the creative gate judges rendered screenshots. A link inside a hydrated island can therefore pass the creative gate and still fail the final whole-page contrast audit, which is what happened: the candidate's hero phone link measured 1.000 against an unmeasured backdrop.

`contrast fail` stays hard (a 1.000 ratio means invisible text, which is critical accessibility), while `contrast unresolved` is already advisory. The correct fix is to make the creative gate audit the hydrated page rather than only screenshots, not to downgrade the check.
